# Qt / PySide6

Qt and PySide6 are independent libraries used under their available open source licenses, including LGPLv3. The application's own MIT license does not replace their licenses. GNU LGPLv3 and GPLv3 texts are provided alongside this notice.

Qt libraries are unmodified and dynamically loaded. In the Windows package, the libraries are under `_internal/PySide6` and `_internal/shiboken6`; users may replace them with compatible modified builds. This application imposes no additional restriction on modification or reverse engineering for debugging such library changes.

Upstream source and build instructions for the 6.11.0 libraries used in this release:

- Qt: https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/6.11/6.11.0/submodules/
- PySide6 / Shiboken: https://download.qt.io/official_releases/QtForPython/pyside6/PySide6-6.11.0-src/
- Qt source repository: https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/qtbase.git/
- PySide source repository: https://code.qt.io/cgit/pyside/pyside-setup.git/

License text sources: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.txt and https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt .
